        <script type="module">
        /* pdf.js, vendored (public/vendor/pdfjs) — no build step in this repo, and the
           field editor must not depend on a third-party host. Legacy 4.x build: pdf.js 6
           calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, which is too new for many browsers.
           Handed to the classic script below through a global and an event. */
        import * as pdfjsLib from "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs";
        pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs";
        window.__pdfjs = pdfjsLib;
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pdfjs-ready"));
        </script>
        <script>
        /* Sidebar chrome — burger + nav group headers (same pattern as documents.html). */
        (function(){
          var side=document.getElementById('side'),b=document.getElementById('burger');
          if(b&&side){
            b.addEventListener('click',function(){
              side.classList.toggle('mini');
              b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';
            });
          }
          document.querySelectorAll('.navhead').forEach(function(h){
            h.addEventListener('click',function(){
              if(side&&side.classList.contains('mini'))return;
              h.parentElement.classList.toggle('closed');
            });
          });
        })();
        </script>
        <script>
        (function () {
          "use strict";
          function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
          function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
            return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }
        
          var templates = [], editing = null;
        
          /* The uploaded-PDF editor's own state. `boxes` is the working copy; nothing
             is written until Save boxes is pressed, so dragging things around cannot
             half-save a layout. */
          var pdfState = { doc: null, boxes: [], roles: [], selected: null, pageEls: [], scale: 1 };
        
          var FIELD_TYPES = [
            { t: "text", label: "Text" }, { t: "date", label: "Date" },
            { t: "checkbox", label: "Tick box" }, { t: "signature", label: "Signature" },
            { t: "initials", label: "Initials" }
          ];
          /* Where a box gets its value. The contact.* entries mirror the merge tags the
             typed-copy editor uses, so somebody who has learned one has learned both. */
          var SOURCES = [
            { v: "manual", label: "The signer types it" },
            { v: "contact.full_name", label: "Client: full name" },
            { v: "contact.first_name", label: "Client: first name" },
            { v: "contact.last_name", label: "Client: last name" },
            { v: "contact.email", label: "Client: email" },
            { v: "contact.phone", label: "Client: phone" },
            { v: "signer.name", label: "This signer's name" },
            { v: "signer.email", label: "This signer's email" },
            { v: "today", label: "Today's date" }
          ];
        
          function say(el, kind, text) {
            el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge ' + kind + '">' +
              (kind === "b-ok" ? "done" : "problem") + "</span> " + esc(text);
          }
        
          /* ── the wording library ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        
          function renderTplList() {
            $("tplList").innerHTML = templates.map(function (t) {
              return '<tr class="rowlink' + (editing && editing.id === t.id ? " sel" : "") +
                '" data-tid="' + esc(t.id) + '"><td class="mono" style="font-size:11.5px">' +
                esc(t.template_key) + "</td><td>" + esc(t.name) +
                (t.source_kind === "pdf"
                  ? ' <span class="badge b-info" style="margin-left:6px">pdf · ' + (t.page_count || "?") + "p</span>"
                  : "") + "</td><td>" +
                (t.active ? '<span class="badge b-ok">in use</span>' : '<span class="badge b-gray">archived</span>') +
                "</td></tr>";
            }).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="3" class="note">No wordings yet. Press “New wording”.</td></tr>';
            Array.prototype.forEach.call($("tplList").querySelectorAll("tr[data-tid]"), function (tr) {
              tr.onclick = function () { editTemplate(tr.getAttribute("data-tid")); };
            });
          }
        
          function renderFieldRows(fields) {
            $("tFields").innerHTML = (fields || []).map(function (f, i) {
              return '<div class="mfrow" data-i="' + i + '">' +
                '<input type="text" data-k="key" value="' + esc(f.key) + '" placeholder="short_name">' +
                '<input type="text" data-k="label" value="' + esc(f.label) + '" placeholder="What to call it">' +
                '<label class="req"><input type="checkbox" data-k="required"' + (f.required ? " checked" : "") + "> needed</label>" +
                '<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-del="' + i + '">×</button></div>';
            }).join("");
            Array.prototype.forEach.call($("tFields").querySelectorAll("[data-del]"), function (b) {
              b.onclick = function () {
                var f = readFieldRows();
                f.splice(Number(b.getAttribute("data-del")), 1);
                renderFieldRows(f);
              };
            });
          }
        
          function readFieldRows() {
            return Array.prototype.map.call($("tFields").querySelectorAll(".mfrow"), function (row) {
              return {
                key: row.querySelector('[data-k="key"]').value.trim(),
                label: row.querySelector('[data-k="label"]').value.trim(),
                required: row.querySelector('[data-k="required"]').checked
              };
            }).filter(function (f) { return f.key; });
          }
        
          function editTemplate(id) {
            for (var i = 0; i < templates.length; i++) {
              if (templates[i].id === id) { editing = templates[i]; break; }
            }
            if (!editing) return;
            /* An uploaded PDF has no typed body and no {{merge tags}} — it has pages and
               boxes. Same card, a different editor, because they are the same act (this
               is the wording of a contract) reached two different ways. */
            var isPdf = editing.source_kind === "pdf";
            $("tplEditor").style.display = isPdf ? "none" : "";
            $("pdfEditor").style.display = isPdf ? "" : "none";
            if (isPdf) { openPdfEditor(editing); renderTplList(); return; }
            $("tKey").value = editing.template_key;
            $("tKey").disabled = true;
            $("tKeyHint").textContent = "The short name cannot be changed — contracts already sent record it.";
            $("tName").value = editing.name;
            $("tKind").value = editing.kind;
            $("tSubtype").value = editing.subtype || "";
            $("tBody").value = editing.body;
            $("tStatement").value = editing.signature_statement;
            renderFieldRows(editing.manual_fields || []);
            $("btnArchive").textContent = editing.active ? "Archive" : "Turn back on";
            $("btnArchive").style.display = "";
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "";
            renderTplList();
            showTags();
          }
        
          function newTemplate() {
            editing = null;
            $("tplEditor").style.display = "";
            $("pdfEditor").style.display = "none";
            $("tKey").value = ""; $("tKey").disabled = false;
            $("tKeyHint").textContent = "Letters, numbers and hyphens. Cannot be changed later.";
            $("tName").value = ""; $("tKind").value = "contract"; $("tSubtype").value = "";
            $("tBody").value = "";
            $("tStatement").value = "I have read this document and I agree to it. Typing my name here is my signature.";
            renderFieldRows([]);
            $("btnArchive").style.display = "none";
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "";
            renderTplList();
            showTags();
          }
        
          var TOKEN_RE = /\{\{\s*(\w+(?:\.\w+)*)\s*\}\}/g;
          function showTags() {
            var seen = {}, out = [], m;
            TOKEN_RE.lastIndex = 0;
            while ((m = TOKEN_RE.exec($("tBody").value))) { if (!seen[m[1]]) { seen[m[1]] = 1; out.push(m[1]); } }
            $("tTags").textContent = out.length ? "blanks used: " + out.join(", ") : "no blanks used yet";
          }
        
          function saveTemplate() {
            var payload = {
              name: $("tName").value, kind: $("tKind").value,
              subtype: $("tSubtype").value || null, body: $("tBody").value,
              manual_fields: readFieldRows(), signature_statement: $("tStatement").value
            };
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "saving…";
            if (editing) { payload.action = "save_template"; payload.id = editing.id; }
            else { payload.action = "create_template"; payload.template_key = $("tKey").value; }
            FHData.write("/api/contracts", payload).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not save"); return; }
              say($("tplMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Saved.");
              editing = res.data.template;
              loadTemplates();
            });
          }
        
          function archiveTemplate() {
            if (!editing) return;
            FHData.write("/api/contracts", {
              action: "archive_template", id: editing.id, active: !editing.active
            }).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not change it"); return; }
              say($("tplMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Done.");
              editing = res.data.template;
              loadTemplates();
            });
          }
        
        
          /* ── the uploaded-PDF field editor ─────────────────────────────────────────
        
             Boxes are stored as FRACTIONS of the page — x, y, w, h between 0 and 1,
             from the top left — and never as pixels. A pixel position only means
             something at the zoom level it was recorded at, so the same box would land
             somewhere else on another screen and somewhere else again in the finished
             PDF. Everything below converts to and from percentages at the last moment.
             See db/migrations/125_contract_esign.sql for the format. */
        
          function waitForPdfjs() {
            if (window.__pdfjs) return Promise.resolve(window.__pdfjs);
            return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
              var t = setTimeout(function () { reject(new Error("the document viewer did not load")); }, 20000);
              window.addEventListener("pdfjs-ready", function () { clearTimeout(t); resolve(window.__pdfjs); });
            });
          }
        
          function b64ToBytes(b64) {
            var raw = atob(b64), out = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
            for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
            return out;
          }
        
          function openPdfEditor(t) {
            $("pdfEditor").style.display = "";
            $("pdfName").textContent = (t.original_filename || "document.pdf") +
              " · " + t.page_count + " page" + (t.page_count === 1 ? "" : "s");
            pdfState.boxes = (t.fields || []).map(function (f) { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(f)); });
            pdfState.roles = (t.signer_roles || []).slice();
            if (!pdfState.roles.length) pdfState.roles = [{ index: 0, label: "Client", fill_from_client: true }];
            pdfState.selected = null;
            renderRoles(); renderTools();
            $("pdfPages").innerHTML = '<div class="note">Loading the document…</div>';
        
            FHData.read("contracts", { file: "template", template_id: t.id }).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok || !res.data || !res.data.pdf_base64) {
                $("pdfPages").innerHTML = '<div class="note">The file could not be loaded.</div>';
                return;
              }
              return waitForPdfjs().then(function (pdfjs) {
                return pdfjs.getDocument({ data: b64ToBytes(res.data.pdf_base64) }).promise;
              }).then(function (doc) {
                pdfState.doc = doc;
                $("pdfPages").innerHTML = "";
                pdfState.pageEls = [];
                var chain = Promise.resolve();
                for (var n = 1; n <= doc.numPages; n++) {
                  (function (num) { chain = chain.then(function () { return drawPage(doc, num); }); })(n);
                }
                return chain.then(renderBoxes);
              });
            }).catch(function (e) {
              $("pdfPages").innerHTML = '<div class="note">' + esc(e.message || "The file could not be shown.") + "</div>";
            });
          }
        
          function drawPage(doc, n) {
            return doc.getPage(n).then(function (page) {
              var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: 1.15 });
              var wrap = document.createElement("div");
              wrap.className = "pg";
              wrap.style.width = vp.width + "px";
              wrap.style.height = vp.height + "px";
              wrap.setAttribute("data-page", n - 1);
              var pn = document.createElement("span");
              pn.className = "pn"; pn.textContent = "page " + n;
              wrap.appendChild(pn);
              var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
              canvas.width = vp.width; canvas.height = vp.height;
              wrap.appendChild(canvas);
              $("pdfPages").appendChild(wrap);
              pdfState.pageEls[n - 1] = wrap;
              wireDrawing(wrap, n - 1);
              return page.render({ canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise;
            });
          }
        
          /* Drag on empty page space to create a box. A drag that ends up smaller than
             a few pixels is treated as a click and creates a default-sized box instead
             — otherwise a slightly-shaky click leaves an invisible one-pixel field on
             the contract. */
          function wireDrawing(wrap, pageIndex) {
            wrap.addEventListener("mousedown", function (ev) {
              if (ev.target !== wrap && ev.target.tagName !== "CANVAS") return;
              ev.preventDefault();
              var r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
              var x0 = (ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y0 = (ev.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
              var ghost = document.createElement("div");
              ghost.className = "box";
              ghost.style.left = (x0 * 100) + "%"; ghost.style.top = (y0 * 100) + "%";
              wrap.appendChild(ghost);
        
              function move(e2) {
                var x1 = (e2.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y1 = (e2.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
                ghost.style.left = (Math.min(x0, x1) * 100) + "%";
                ghost.style.top = (Math.min(y0, y1) * 100) + "%";
                ghost.style.width = (Math.abs(x1 - x0) * 100) + "%";
                ghost.style.height = (Math.abs(y1 - y0) * 100) + "%";
              }
              function up(e2) {
                document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
                document.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
                ghost.remove();
                var x1 = (e2.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y1 = (e2.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
                var w = Math.abs(x1 - x0), h = Math.abs(y1 - y0);
                var type = currentType();
                if (w < 0.02 || h < 0.008) { w = type === "checkbox" ? 0.03 : 0.25; h = type === "checkbox" ? 0.02 : 0.028; }
                addBox({
                  page: pageIndex,
                  x: clamp01(Math.min(x0, x1)), y: clamp01(Math.min(y0, y1)),
                  w: w, h: h, type: type,
                  signer: Number($("newSigner").value || 0),
                  source: type === "signature" || type === "initials" ? "manual" : $("newSource").value
                });
              }
              document.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
              document.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
            });
          }
        
          function clamp01(v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); }
          function currentType() {
            var on = $("typeChips").querySelector(".chip2.on");
            return on ? on.getAttribute("data-type") : "text";
          }
        
          function addBox(b) {
            var n = 1;
            while (pdfState.boxes.some(function (x) { return x.id === "f" + n; })) n++;
            // Keep it on the page even if the drag ran off the edge — the server
            // refuses an off-page box, and refusing here would just lose the work.
            b.w = Math.min(b.w, 1 - b.x); b.h = Math.min(b.h, 1 - b.y);
            b.id = "f" + n;
            b.label = defaultLabelFor(b);
            b.required = true;
            pdfState.boxes.push(b);
            pdfState.selected = b.id;
            renderBoxes(); renderTools();
          }
        
          function defaultLabelFor(b) {
            var src = SOURCES.filter(function (s2) { return s2.v === b.source; })[0];
            if (b.source !== "manual" && src) return src.label.replace(/^Client: /, "");
            return FIELD_TYPES.filter(function (t) { return t.t === b.type; })[0].label;
          }
        
          function renderBoxes() {
            pdfState.pageEls.forEach(function (wrap) {
              if (!wrap) return;
              Array.prototype.forEach.call(wrap.querySelectorAll(".box"), function (el) { el.remove(); });
            });
            pdfState.boxes.forEach(function (b) {
              var wrap = pdfState.pageEls[b.page];
              if (!wrap) return;
              var el = document.createElement("div");
              el.className = "box s" + (Number(b.signer) % 3) + (pdfState.selected === b.id ? " sel" : "");
              el.style.left = (b.x * 100) + "%"; el.style.top = (b.y * 100) + "%";
              el.style.width = (b.w * 100) + "%"; el.style.height = (b.h * 100) + "%";
              el.setAttribute("data-id", b.id);
              var lbl = document.createElement("span");
              lbl.className = "bl";
              lbl.textContent = b.label + (b.source !== "manual" ? " ⟨auto⟩" : "");
              el.appendChild(lbl);
              var h = document.createElement("span");
              h.className = "h";
              el.appendChild(h);
              wrap.appendChild(el);
              wireBox(el, b, wrap, h);
            });
          }
        
          function wireBox(el, b, wrap, handle) {
            el.addEventListener("mousedown", function (ev) {
              ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault();
              pdfState.selected = b.id; renderBoxes(); renderTools();
              var resizing = ev.target === handle;
              var r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
              var sx = ev.clientX, sy = ev.clientY, ox = b.x, oy = b.y, ow = b.w, oh = b.h;
              function move(e2) {
                var dx = (e2.clientX - sx) / r.width, dy = (e2.clientY - sy) / r.height;
                if (resizing) {
                  b.w = Math.max(0.012, Math.min(1 - b.x, ow + dx));
                  b.h = Math.max(0.008, Math.min(1 - b.y, oh + dy));
                } else {
                  b.x = clamp01(Math.min(1 - b.w, ox + dx));
                  b.y = clamp01(Math.min(1 - b.h, oy + dy));
                }
                el.style.left = (b.x * 100) + "%"; el.style.top = (b.y * 100) + "%";
                el.style.width = (b.w * 100) + "%"; el.style.height = (b.h * 100) + "%";
              }
              function up() {
                document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
                document.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
              }
              document.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
              document.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
            });
          }
        
          function renderTools() {
            $("typeChips").innerHTML = FIELD_TYPES.map(function (t, i) {
              return '<button class="chip2' + (i === 0 ? " on" : "") + '" data-type="' + t.t + '">' +
                esc(t.label) + "</button>";
            }).join("");
            Array.prototype.forEach.call($("typeChips").querySelectorAll(".chip2"), function (c) {
              c.onclick = function () {
                Array.prototype.forEach.call($("typeChips").querySelectorAll(".chip2"), function (x) {
                  x.className = "chip2";
                });
                c.className = "chip2 on";
              };
            });
            $("newSigner").innerHTML = pdfState.roles.map(function (r, i) {
              return '<option value="' + i + '">' + esc(r.label) + "</option>";
            }).join("");
            $("newSource").innerHTML = SOURCES.map(function (s2) {
              return '<option value="' + s2.v + '">' + esc(s2.label) + "</option>";
            }).join("");
        
            var b = pdfState.boxes.filter(function (x) { return x.id === pdfState.selected; })[0];
            if (!b) { $("boxProps").innerHTML = "Nothing selected."; return; }
            $("boxProps").innerHTML =
              '<div class="row"><label>Name on screen</label><input type="text" id="bpLabel" value="' + esc(b.label) + '"></div>' +
              '<div class="row"><label>Kind</label><select id="bpType">' +
                FIELD_TYPES.map(function (t) {
                  return '<option value="' + t.t + '"' + (t.t === b.type ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(t.label) + "</option>";
                }).join("") + "</select></div>" +
              '<div class="row"><label>Belongs to</label><select id="bpSigner">' +
                pdfState.roles.map(function (r, i) {
                  return '<option value="' + i + '"' + (i === Number(b.signer) ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(r.label) + "</option>";
                }).join("") + "</select></div>" +
              '<div class="row"><label>Filled from</label><select id="bpSource">' +
                SOURCES.map(function (s2) {
                  return '<option value="' + s2.v + '"' + (s2.v === b.source ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(s2.label) + "</option>";
                }).join("") + "</select></div>" +
              '<div class="row"><label style="display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:11.5px;font-family:var(--sans)">' +
                '<input type="checkbox" id="bpReq"' + (b.required ? " checked" : "") + "> Must be filled in</label></div>" +
              '<button class="btn sm" id="bpDel" type="button" style="width:100%">Remove this box</button>';
        
            $("bpLabel").oninput = function () { b.label = $("bpLabel").value; renderBoxes(); };
            $("bpType").onchange = function () {
              b.type = $("bpType").value;
              // A signature can never be filled in for somebody — the server refuses it
              // too, so the screen matches rather than letting them save and be told no.
              if (b.type === "signature" || b.type === "initials") b.source = "manual";
              renderBoxes(); renderTools();
            };
            $("bpSigner").onchange = function () { b.signer = Number($("bpSigner").value); renderBoxes(); };
            $("bpSource").onchange = function () {
              b.source = $("bpSource").value;
              if (b.source !== "manual" && (b.type === "signature" || b.type === "initials")) b.type = "text";
              renderBoxes(); renderTools();
            };
            $("bpReq").onchange = function () { b.required = $("bpReq").checked; };
            $("bpDel").onclick = function () {
              pdfState.boxes = pdfState.boxes.filter(function (x) { return x.id !== b.id; });
              pdfState.selected = null; renderBoxes(); renderTools();
            };
          }
        
          function renderRoles() {
            $("signerRoles").innerHTML = pdfState.roles.map(function (r, i) {
              return '<span class="badge b-gray" style="margin-right:6px">' + (i + 1) + ". " + esc(r.label) + "</span>";
            }).join("") + (pdfState.roles.length > 1
              ? ' <span class="note" style="margin:0">They sign in this order.</span>' : "");
          }
        
          function saveFields() {
            if (!editing) return;
            $("fieldMsg").textContent = "saving…";
            FHData.write("/api/contracts", {
              action: "save_fields", id: editing.id,
              fields: pdfState.boxes, signer_roles: pdfState.roles
            }).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) { say($("fieldMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not save the boxes"); return; }
              say($("fieldMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Saved.");
              editing = res.data.template;
              loadTemplates();
            });
          }
        
          function uploadPdf(file) {
            var name = window.prompt("Give this document a short name (letters, numbers and hyphens):",
              file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, "").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "-").slice(0, 40));
            if (name == null || !name.trim()) return;
            var reader = new FileReader();
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "uploading…";
            reader.onload = function () {
              FHData.write("/api/contracts", {
                action: "upload_template",
                template_key: name,
                name: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
                filename: file.name,
                file: String(reader.result)
              }).then(function (res) {
                if (!res.ok) { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not upload that file"); return; }
                say($("tplMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Uploaded.");
                loadTemplates().then(function () { editTemplate(res.data.template.id); });
              });
            };
            reader.onerror = function () { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", "that file could not be read"); };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
          }
        
          /* ── loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        
          function loadTemplates() {
            return FHData.wire(FHData.read("contracts", { view: "templates" }), "contract wordings", function (data) {
              templates = (data && data.items) || [];
              renderTplList();
              $("liveTxt").textContent = "— live";
              if (editing) {
                for (var i = 0; i < templates.length; i++) if (templates[i].id === editing.id) editing = templates[i];
              }
              return "live wordings · " + templates.length;
            });
          }
        
          /* ── boot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        
          $("btnUpload").onclick = function () { $("fileInput").click(); };
          $("fileInput").onchange = function () {
            if (this.files && this.files[0]) uploadPdf(this.files[0]);
            this.value = "";
          };
          $("btnSaveFields").onclick = saveFields;
          $("btnAddSigner").onclick = function () {
            pdfState.roles.push({ index: pdfState.roles.length, label: "Signer " + (pdfState.roles.length + 1) });
            renderRoles(); renderTools();
          };
          $("btnNewTpl").onclick = newTemplate;
          $("btnSaveTpl").onclick = saveTemplate;
          $("btnArchive").onclick = archiveTemplate;
          $("btnCancelTpl").onclick = function () { $("tplEditor").style.display = "none"; editing = null; renderTplList(); };
          $("btnAddField").onclick = function () {
            var f = readFieldRows();
            f.push({ key: "", label: "", required: false });
            renderFieldRows(f);
          };
          $("tBody").addEventListener("input", showTags);
        
          loadTemplates();
        })();

        <script defer src="data.js"></script>
        <script type="module">
        /* pdf.js, vendored (public/vendor/pdfjs) — no build step in this repo, and the
           field editor must not depend on a third-party host. Legacy 4.x build: pdf.js 6
           calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, which is too new for many browsers.
           Handed to the classic script below through a global and an event. */
        import * as pdfjsLib from "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs";
        pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs";
        window.__pdfjs = pdfjsLib;
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pdfjs-ready"));
        </script>
        <script>
        /* Sidebar chrome — burger + nav group headers (same pattern as documents.html). */
        (function(){
          var side=document.getElementById('side'),b=document.getElementById('burger');
          if(b&&side){
            b.addEventListener('click',function(){
              side.classList.toggle('mini');
              b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';
            });
          }
          document.querySelectorAll('.navhead').forEach(function(h){
            h.addEventListener('click',function(){
              if(side&&side.classList.contains('mini'))return;
              h.parentElement.classList.toggle('closed');
            });
          });
        })();
        </script>
        <script>
        (function () {
          "use strict";
          function $(id) { return document.getElementById(id); }
          function esc(s) { return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
            return { "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[c]; }); }
        
          var templates = [], editing = null;
        
          /* The uploaded-PDF editor's own state. `boxes` is the working copy; nothing
             is written until Save boxes is pressed, so dragging things around cannot
             half-save a layout. */
          var pdfState = { doc: null, boxes: [], roles: [], selected: null, pageEls: [], scale: 1 };
        
          var FIELD_TYPES = [
            { t: "text", label: "Text" }, { t: "date", label: "Date" },
            { t: "checkbox", label: "Tick box" }, { t: "signature", label: "Signature" },
            { t: "initials", label: "Initials" }
          ];
          /* Where a box gets its value. The contact.* entries mirror the merge tags the
             typed-copy editor uses, so somebody who has learned one has learned both. */
          var SOURCES = [
            { v: "manual", label: "The signer types it" },
            { v: "contact.full_name", label: "Client: full name" },
            { v: "contact.first_name", label: "Client: first name" },
            { v: "contact.last_name", label: "Client: last name" },
            { v: "contact.email", label: "Client: email" },
            { v: "contact.phone", label: "Client: phone" },
            { v: "signer.name", label: "This signer's name" },
            { v: "signer.email", label: "This signer's email" },
            { v: "today", label: "Today's date" }
          ];
        
          function say(el, kind, text) {
            el.innerHTML = '<span class="badge ' + kind + '">' +
              (kind === "b-ok" ? "done" : "problem") + "</span> " + esc(text);
          }
        
          /* ── the wording library ───────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        
          function renderTplList() {
            $("tplList").innerHTML = templates.map(function (t) {
              return '<tr class="rowlink' + (editing && editing.id === t.id ? " sel" : "") +
                '" data-tid="' + esc(t.id) + '"><td class="mono" style="font-size:11.5px">' +
                esc(t.template_key) + "</td><td>" + esc(t.name) +
                (t.source_kind === "pdf"
                  ? ' <span class="badge b-info" style="margin-left:6px">pdf · ' + (t.page_count || "?") + "p</span>"
                  : "") + "</td><td>" +
                (t.active ? '<span class="badge b-ok">in use</span>' : '<span class="badge b-gray">archived</span>') +
                "</td></tr>";
            }).join("") || '<tr><td colspan="3" class="note">No wordings yet. Press “New wording”.</td></tr>';
            Array.prototype.forEach.call($("tplList").querySelectorAll("tr[data-tid]"), function (tr) {
              tr.onclick = function () { editTemplate(tr.getAttribute("data-tid")); };
            });
          }
        
          function renderFieldRows(fields) {
            $("tFields").innerHTML = (fields || []).map(function (f, i) {
              return '<div class="mfrow" data-i="' + i + '">' +
                '<input type="text" data-k="key" value="' + esc(f.key) + '" placeholder="short_name">' +
                '<input type="text" data-k="label" value="' + esc(f.label) + '" placeholder="What to call it">' +
                '<label class="req"><input type="checkbox" data-k="required"' + (f.required ? " checked" : "") + "> needed</label>" +
                '<button class="btn sm" type="button" data-del="' + i + '">×</button></div>';
            }).join("");
            Array.prototype.forEach.call($("tFields").querySelectorAll("[data-del]"), function (b) {
              b.onclick = function () {
                var f = readFieldRows();
                f.splice(Number(b.getAttribute("data-del")), 1);
                renderFieldRows(f);
              };
            });
          }
        
          function readFieldRows() {
            return Array.prototype.map.call($("tFields").querySelectorAll(".mfrow"), function (row) {
              return {
                key: row.querySelector('[data-k="key"]').value.trim(),
                label: row.querySelector('[data-k="label"]').value.trim(),
                required: row.querySelector('[data-k="required"]').checked
              };
            }).filter(function (f) { return f.key; });
          }
        
          function editTemplate(id) {
            for (var i = 0; i < templates.length; i++) {
              if (templates[i].id === id) { editing = templates[i]; break; }
            }
            if (!editing) return;
            /* An uploaded PDF has no typed body and no {{merge tags}} — it has pages and
               boxes. Same card, a different editor, because they are the same act (this
               is the wording of a contract) reached two different ways. */
            var isPdf = editing.source_kind === "pdf";
            $("tplEditor").style.display = isPdf ? "none" : "";
            $("pdfEditor").style.display = isPdf ? "" : "none";
            if (isPdf) { openPdfEditor(editing); renderTplList(); return; }
            $("tKey").value = editing.template_key;
            $("tKey").disabled = true;
            $("tKeyHint").textContent = "The short name cannot be changed — contracts already sent record it.";
            $("tName").value = editing.name;
            $("tKind").value = editing.kind;
            $("tSubtype").value = editing.subtype || "";
            $("tBody").value = editing.body;
            $("tStatement").value = editing.signature_statement;
            renderFieldRows(editing.manual_fields || []);
            $("btnArchive").textContent = editing.active ? "Archive" : "Turn back on";
            $("btnArchive").style.display = "";
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "";
            renderTplList();
            showTags();
          }
        
          function newTemplate() {
            editing = null;
            $("tplEditor").style.display = "";
            $("pdfEditor").style.display = "none";
            $("tKey").value = ""; $("tKey").disabled = false;
            $("tKeyHint").textContent = "Letters, numbers and hyphens. Cannot be changed later.";
            $("tName").value = ""; $("tKind").value = "contract"; $("tSubtype").value = "";
            $("tBody").value = "";
            $("tStatement").value = "I have read this document and I agree to it. Typing my name here is my signature.";
            renderFieldRows([]);
            $("btnArchive").style.display = "none";
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "";
            renderTplList();
            showTags();
          }
        
          var TOKEN_RE = /\{\{\s*(\w+(?:\.\w+)*)\s*\}\}/g;
          function showTags() {
            var seen = {}, out = [], m;
            TOKEN_RE.lastIndex = 0;
            while ((m = TOKEN_RE.exec($("tBody").value))) { if (!seen[m[1]]) { seen[m[1]] = 1; out.push(m[1]); } }
            $("tTags").textContent = out.length ? "blanks used: " + out.join(", ") : "no blanks used yet";
          }
        
          function saveTemplate() {
            var payload = {
              name: $("tName").value, kind: $("tKind").value,
              subtype: $("tSubtype").value || null, body: $("tBody").value,
              manual_fields: readFieldRows(), signature_statement: $("tStatement").value
            };
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "saving…";
            if (editing) { payload.action = "save_template"; payload.id = editing.id; }
            else { payload.action = "create_template"; payload.template_key = $("tKey").value; }
            FHData.write("/api/contracts", payload).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not save"); return; }
              say($("tplMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Saved.");
              editing = res.data.template;
              loadTemplates();
            });
          }
        
          function archiveTemplate() {
            if (!editing) return;
            FHData.write("/api/contracts", {
              action: "archive_template", id: editing.id, active: !editing.active
            }).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not change it"); return; }
              say($("tplMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Done.");
              editing = res.data.template;
              loadTemplates();
            });
          }
        
        
          /* ── the uploaded-PDF field editor ─────────────────────────────────────────
        
             Boxes are stored as FRACTIONS of the page — x, y, w, h between 0 and 1,
             from the top left — and never as pixels. A pixel position only means
             something at the zoom level it was recorded at, so the same box would land
             somewhere else on another screen and somewhere else again in the finished
             PDF. Everything below converts to and from percentages at the last moment.
             See db/migrations/125_contract_esign.sql for the format. */
        
          function waitForPdfjs() {
            if (window.__pdfjs) return Promise.resolve(window.__pdfjs);
            return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
              var t = setTimeout(function () { reject(new Error("the document viewer did not load")); }, 20000);
              window.addEventListener("pdfjs-ready", function () { clearTimeout(t); resolve(window.__pdfjs); });
            });
          }
        
          function b64ToBytes(b64) {
            var raw = atob(b64), out = new Uint8Array(raw.length);
            for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
            return out;
          }
        
          function openPdfEditor(t) {
            $("pdfEditor").style.display = "";
            $("pdfName").textContent = (t.original_filename || "document.pdf") +
              " · " + t.page_count + " page" + (t.page_count === 1 ? "" : "s");
            pdfState.boxes = (t.fields || []).map(function (f) { return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(f)); });
            pdfState.roles = (t.signer_roles || []).slice();
            if (!pdfState.roles.length) pdfState.roles = [{ index: 0, label: "Client", fill_from_client: true }];
            pdfState.selected = null;
            renderRoles(); renderTools();
            $("pdfPages").innerHTML = '<div class="note">Loading the document…</div>';
        
            FHData.read("contracts", { file: "template", template_id: t.id }).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok || !res.data || !res.data.pdf_base64) {
                $("pdfPages").innerHTML = '<div class="note">The file could not be loaded.</div>';
                return;
              }
              return waitForPdfjs().then(function (pdfjs) {
                return pdfjs.getDocument({ data: b64ToBytes(res.data.pdf_base64) }).promise;
              }).then(function (doc) {
                pdfState.doc = doc;
                $("pdfPages").innerHTML = "";
                pdfState.pageEls = [];
                var chain = Promise.resolve();
                for (var n = 1; n <= doc.numPages; n++) {
                  (function (num) { chain = chain.then(function () { return drawPage(doc, num); }); })(n);
                }
                return chain.then(renderBoxes);
              });
            }).catch(function (e) {
              $("pdfPages").innerHTML = '<div class="note">' + esc(e.message || "The file could not be shown.") + "</div>";
            });
          }
        
          function drawPage(doc, n) {
            return doc.getPage(n).then(function (page) {
              var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: 1.15 });
              var wrap = document.createElement("div");
              wrap.className = "pg";
              wrap.style.width = vp.width + "px";
              wrap.style.height = vp.height + "px";
              wrap.setAttribute("data-page", n - 1);
              var pn = document.createElement("span");
              pn.className = "pn"; pn.textContent = "page " + n;
              wrap.appendChild(pn);
              var canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
              canvas.width = vp.width; canvas.height = vp.height;
              wrap.appendChild(canvas);
              $("pdfPages").appendChild(wrap);
              pdfState.pageEls[n - 1] = wrap;
              wireDrawing(wrap, n - 1);
              return page.render({ canvasContext: canvas.getContext("2d"), viewport: vp }).promise;
            });
          }
        
          /* Drag on empty page space to create a box. A drag that ends up smaller than
             a few pixels is treated as a click and creates a default-sized box instead
             — otherwise a slightly-shaky click leaves an invisible one-pixel field on
             the contract. */
          function wireDrawing(wrap, pageIndex) {
            wrap.addEventListener("mousedown", function (ev) {
              if (ev.target !== wrap && ev.target.tagName !== "CANVAS") return;
              ev.preventDefault();
              var r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
              var x0 = (ev.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y0 = (ev.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
              var ghost = document.createElement("div");
              ghost.className = "box";
              ghost.style.left = (x0 * 100) + "%"; ghost.style.top = (y0 * 100) + "%";
              wrap.appendChild(ghost);
        
              function move(e2) {
                var x1 = (e2.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y1 = (e2.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
                ghost.style.left = (Math.min(x0, x1) * 100) + "%";
                ghost.style.top = (Math.min(y0, y1) * 100) + "%";
                ghost.style.width = (Math.abs(x1 - x0) * 100) + "%";
                ghost.style.height = (Math.abs(y1 - y0) * 100) + "%";
              }
              function up(e2) {
                document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
                document.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
                ghost.remove();
                var x1 = (e2.clientX - r.left) / r.width, y1 = (e2.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
                var w = Math.abs(x1 - x0), h = Math.abs(y1 - y0);
                var type = currentType();
                if (w < 0.02 || h < 0.008) { w = type === "checkbox" ? 0.03 : 0.25; h = type === "checkbox" ? 0.02 : 0.028; }
                addBox({
                  page: pageIndex,
                  x: clamp01(Math.min(x0, x1)), y: clamp01(Math.min(y0, y1)),
                  w: w, h: h, type: type,
                  signer: Number($("newSigner").value || 0),
                  source: type === "signature" || type === "initials" ? "manual" : $("newSource").value
                });
              }
              document.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
              document.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
            });
          }
        
          function clamp01(v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v)); }
          function currentType() {
            var on = $("typeChips").querySelector(".chip2.on");
            return on ? on.getAttribute("data-type") : "text";
          }
        
          function addBox(b) {
            var n = 1;
            while (pdfState.boxes.some(function (x) { return x.id === "f" + n; })) n++;
            // Keep it on the page even if the drag ran off the edge — the server
            // refuses an off-page box, and refusing here would just lose the work.
            b.w = Math.min(b.w, 1 - b.x); b.h = Math.min(b.h, 1 - b.y);
            b.id = "f" + n;
            b.label = defaultLabelFor(b);
            b.required = true;
            pdfState.boxes.push(b);
            pdfState.selected = b.id;
            renderBoxes(); renderTools();
          }
        
          function defaultLabelFor(b) {
            var src = SOURCES.filter(function (s2) { return s2.v === b.source; })[0];
            if (b.source !== "manual" && src) return src.label.replace(/^Client: /, "");
            return FIELD_TYPES.filter(function (t) { return t.t === b.type; })[0].label;
          }
        
          function renderBoxes() {
            pdfState.pageEls.forEach(function (wrap) {
              if (!wrap) return;
              Array.prototype.forEach.call(wrap.querySelectorAll(".box"), function (el) { el.remove(); });
            });
            pdfState.boxes.forEach(function (b) {
              var wrap = pdfState.pageEls[b.page];
              if (!wrap) return;
              var el = document.createElement("div");
              el.className = "box s" + (Number(b.signer) % 3) + (pdfState.selected === b.id ? " sel" : "");
              el.style.left = (b.x * 100) + "%"; el.style.top = (b.y * 100) + "%";
              el.style.width = (b.w * 100) + "%"; el.style.height = (b.h * 100) + "%";
              el.setAttribute("data-id", b.id);
              var lbl = document.createElement("span");
              lbl.className = "bl";
              lbl.textContent = b.label + (b.source !== "manual" ? " ⟨auto⟩" : "");
              el.appendChild(lbl);
              var h = document.createElement("span");
              h.className = "h";
              el.appendChild(h);
              wrap.appendChild(el);
              wireBox(el, b, wrap, h);
            });
          }
        
          function wireBox(el, b, wrap, handle) {
            el.addEventListener("mousedown", function (ev) {
              ev.stopPropagation(); ev.preventDefault();
              pdfState.selected = b.id; renderBoxes(); renderTools();
              var resizing = ev.target === handle;
              var r = wrap.getBoundingClientRect();
              var sx = ev.clientX, sy = ev.clientY, ox = b.x, oy = b.y, ow = b.w, oh = b.h;
              function move(e2) {
                var dx = (e2.clientX - sx) / r.width, dy = (e2.clientY - sy) / r.height;
                if (resizing) {
                  b.w = Math.max(0.012, Math.min(1 - b.x, ow + dx));
                  b.h = Math.max(0.008, Math.min(1 - b.y, oh + dy));
                } else {
                  b.x = clamp01(Math.min(1 - b.w, ox + dx));
                  b.y = clamp01(Math.min(1 - b.h, oy + dy));
                }
                el.style.left = (b.x * 100) + "%"; el.style.top = (b.y * 100) + "%";
                el.style.width = (b.w * 100) + "%"; el.style.height = (b.h * 100) + "%";
              }
              function up() {
                document.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
                document.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
              }
              document.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
              document.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
            });
          }
        
          function renderTools() {
            $("typeChips").innerHTML = FIELD_TYPES.map(function (t, i) {
              return '<button class="chip2' + (i === 0 ? " on" : "") + '" data-type="' + t.t + '">' +
                esc(t.label) + "</button>";
            }).join("");
            Array.prototype.forEach.call($("typeChips").querySelectorAll(".chip2"), function (c) {
              c.onclick = function () {
                Array.prototype.forEach.call($("typeChips").querySelectorAll(".chip2"), function (x) {
                  x.className = "chip2";
                });
                c.className = "chip2 on";
              };
            });
            $("newSigner").innerHTML = pdfState.roles.map(function (r, i) {
              return '<option value="' + i + '">' + esc(r.label) + "</option>";
            }).join("");
            $("newSource").innerHTML = SOURCES.map(function (s2) {
              return '<option value="' + s2.v + '">' + esc(s2.label) + "</option>";
            }).join("");
        
            var b = pdfState.boxes.filter(function (x) { return x.id === pdfState.selected; })[0];
            if (!b) { $("boxProps").innerHTML = "Nothing selected."; return; }
            $("boxProps").innerHTML =
              '<div class="row"><label>Name on screen</label><input type="text" id="bpLabel" value="' + esc(b.label) + '"></div>' +
              '<div class="row"><label>Kind</label><select id="bpType">' +
                FIELD_TYPES.map(function (t) {
                  return '<option value="' + t.t + '"' + (t.t === b.type ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(t.label) + "</option>";
                }).join("") + "</select></div>" +
              '<div class="row"><label>Belongs to</label><select id="bpSigner">' +
                pdfState.roles.map(function (r, i) {
                  return '<option value="' + i + '"' + (i === Number(b.signer) ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(r.label) + "</option>";
                }).join("") + "</select></div>" +
              '<div class="row"><label>Filled from</label><select id="bpSource">' +
                SOURCES.map(function (s2) {
                  return '<option value="' + s2.v + '"' + (s2.v === b.source ? " selected" : "") + ">" + esc(s2.label) + "</option>";
                }).join("") + "</select></div>" +
              '<div class="row"><label style="display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:11.5px;font-family:var(--sans)">' +
                '<input type="checkbox" id="bpReq"' + (b.required ? " checked" : "") + "> Must be filled in</label></div>" +
              '<button class="btn sm" id="bpDel" type="button" style="width:100%">Remove this box</button>';
        
            $("bpLabel").oninput = function () { b.label = $("bpLabel").value; renderBoxes(); };
            $("bpType").onchange = function () {
              b.type = $("bpType").value;
              // A signature can never be filled in for somebody — the server refuses it
              // too, so the screen matches rather than letting them save and be told no.
              if (b.type === "signature" || b.type === "initials") b.source = "manual";
              renderBoxes(); renderTools();
            };
            $("bpSigner").onchange = function () { b.signer = Number($("bpSigner").value); renderBoxes(); };
            $("bpSource").onchange = function () {
              b.source = $("bpSource").value;
              if (b.source !== "manual" && (b.type === "signature" || b.type === "initials")) b.type = "text";
              renderBoxes(); renderTools();
            };
            $("bpReq").onchange = function () { b.required = $("bpReq").checked; };
            $("bpDel").onclick = function () {
              pdfState.boxes = pdfState.boxes.filter(function (x) { return x.id !== b.id; });
              pdfState.selected = null; renderBoxes(); renderTools();
            };
          }
        
          function renderRoles() {
            $("signerRoles").innerHTML = pdfState.roles.map(function (r, i) {
              return '<span class="badge b-gray" style="margin-right:6px">' + (i + 1) + ". " + esc(r.label) + "</span>";
            }).join("") + (pdfState.roles.length > 1
              ? ' <span class="note" style="margin:0">They sign in this order.</span>' : "");
          }
        
          function saveFields() {
            if (!editing) return;
            $("fieldMsg").textContent = "saving…";
            FHData.write("/api/contracts", {
              action: "save_fields", id: editing.id,
              fields: pdfState.boxes, signer_roles: pdfState.roles
            }).then(function (res) {
              if (!res.ok) { say($("fieldMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not save the boxes"); return; }
              say($("fieldMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Saved.");
              editing = res.data.template;
              loadTemplates();
            });
          }
        
          function uploadPdf(file) {
            var name = window.prompt("Give this document a short name (letters, numbers and hyphens):",
              file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, "").toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]+/g, "-").slice(0, 40));
            if (name == null || !name.trim()) return;
            var reader = new FileReader();
            $("tplMsg").textContent = "uploading…";
            reader.onload = function () {
              FHData.write("/api/contracts", {
                action: "upload_template",
                template_key: name,
                name: file.name.replace(/\.pdf$/i, ""),
                filename: file.name,
                file: String(reader.result)
              }).then(function (res) {
                if (!res.ok) { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", res.error || "could not upload that file"); return; }
                say($("tplMsg"), "b-ok", (res.data && res.data.message) || "Uploaded.");
                loadTemplates().then(function () { editTemplate(res.data.template.id); });
              });
            };
            reader.onerror = function () { say($("tplMsg"), "b-alert", "that file could not be read"); };
            reader.readAsDataURL(file);
          }
        
          /* ── loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        
          function loadTemplates() {
            return FHData.wire(FHData.read("contracts", { view: "templates" }), "contract wordings", function (data) {
              templates = (data && data.items) || [];
              renderTplList();
              $("liveTxt").textContent = "— live";
              if (editing) {
                for (var i = 0; i < templates.length; i++) if (templates[i].id === editing.id) editing = templates[i];
              }
              return "live wordings · " + templates.length;
            });
          }
        
          /* ── boot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        
          $("btnUpload").onclick = function () { $("fileInput").click(); };
          $("fileInput").onchange = function () {
            if (this.files && this.files[0]) uploadPdf(this.files[0]);
            this.value = "";
          };
          $("btnSaveFields").onclick = saveFields;
          $("btnAddSigner").onclick = function () {
            pdfState.roles.push({ index: pdfState.roles.length, label: "Signer " + (pdfState.roles.length + 1) });
            renderRoles(); renderTools();

          $("btnNewTpl").onclick = newTemplate;
          $("btnSaveTpl").onclick = saveTemplate;
          $("btnArchive").onclick = archiveTemplate;
          $("btnCancelTpl").onclick = function () { $("tplEditor").style.display = "none"; editing = null; renderTplList(); };
          $("btnAddField").onclick = function () {
            var f = readFieldRows();
            f.push({ key: "", label: "", required: false });
            renderFieldRows(f);
          };
          $("tBody").addEventListener("input", showTags);
        
          loadTemplates();
        })();

        <script type="module">
        /* pdf.js, vendored (public/vendor/pdfjs) — no build step in this repo, and the
           field editor must not depend on a third-party host. Legacy 4.x build: pdf.js 6
           calls Map.prototype.getOrInsertComputed, which is too new for many browsers.
           Handed to the classic script below through a global and an event. */
        import * as pdfjsLib from "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.min.mjs";
        pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = "/vendor/pdfjs/pdf.worker.min.mjs";
        window.__pdfjs = pdfjsLib;
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("pdfjs-ready"));
        </script>

        /* Sidebar chrome — burger + nav group headers (same pattern as documents.html). */
        (function(){
          var side=document.getElementById('side'),b=document.getElementById('burger');
          if(b&&side){
            b.addEventListener('click',function(){
              side.classList.toggle('mini');
              b.textContent=side.classList.contains('mini')?'››':'‹‹';
            });
          }
          document.querySelectorAll('.navhead').forEach(function(h){
            h.addEventListener('click',function(){
              if(side&&side.classList.contains('mini'))return;
              h.parentElement.classList.toggle('closed');
            });
          });
        })();
        </script>
